note: Elemental boss responses include the per-dungeon utility notes from Wowhead's Elemental M+ tips (Poison Cleansing Totem, Cleanse Spirit, Purge targets, where marked). The rest apply the rotation guide's general principles to each mechanic (Ascendance after Stormkeeper in burst windows, Astral Shift for big AoE damage, Spiritwalker's Grace and Gust of Wind for movement).

answers.dispel.disease: Handled by a party member who can dispel

general.name: Common
general.sub: Kit summary · pick your Hero talent above

i: tip
Using Stormkeeper (1 min) summons an Ancestor for 8 sec via Call of the Ancestors, which copies your spells. Use Stormkeeper on cooldown (Wowhead)
tip
Ancestral Swiftness (30 sec) replaces Nature's Swiftness. Your next spell is instant and deals 10% more damage. Use it on cooldown or save it for movement
tip
The Ancestor casts Lava Burst whenever Flame Shock is newly applied. Line it up with the moment Voltaic Blaze or Ascendance applies Flame Shock (Wowhead)
tip
In Wowhead's build table, every raid, M+, and Delve ★ is on Farseer only, and all 8 per-dungeon builds are Farseer M+ codes. Poison Cleansing Totem is only in the Farseer build
tip
Each time you spend Maelstrom, there's a chance your next Lightning Bolt becomes Tempest. Arc Discharge: casting Tempest grants 1 Stormkeeper charge
tip
Stormkeeper's cooldown is reduced by 15 sec each by Herald of the Storms and Rolling Thunder. Use it on cooldown
tip
Your spender is Earth Shock (60 Maelstrom) instead of Elemental Blast. For AoE, both hero talents use Earthquake
tip
The Stormbringer M+ build has no Poison Cleansing Totem, but has Earthgrab Totem and Static Charge
tip

Stormkeeper · 1 min (shorter for Stormbringer via reduction talents) · 1.5 sec cast. Your next 2 Lightning Bolts are instant with 150% more damage, or your next 2 Chain Lightnings are instant and overload on every target. On cooldown
tip

Ascendance · 2 min (First Ascendant) · 15 sec transformation; applies Flame Shock and a 50% Lava Burst to up to 6 nearby enemies. Call of Fire summons a Greater Fire Elemental for 20 sec. Always use it after Stormkeeper (Wowhead)
tip
Voltaic Blaze · 10 sec · applies Flame Shock and deals damage to the target and up to 5 nearby enemies; always crits. On cooldown in AoE
tip
Bloodlust/Heroism · 5 min · 30% party Haste for 40 sec. Coordinate timing with the party
tb
Astral Shift · 2 min · 40% less damage taken for 12 sec. Elemental's only major defensive, so assign it to big AoE damage
tb
Nature's Guardian · dropping below 35% health instantly heals 40% max health (1 per 45 sec; more often for Farseer via Natural Harmony)
tb

Keep both Earth Shield and Lightning Shield up (Elemental Orbit); in an emergency, use Nature's Swiftness/Ancestral Swiftness for an instant Healing Surge. Elemental Warding reduces magic damage taken by 8%
int
Wind Shear · 12 sec · 30-yard interrupt, locks the school for 4 sec. Short cooldown, so it goes into the interrupt rotation often
cc
Capacitor Totem · 1 min (45 sec for Stormbringer via Static Charge) · stuns enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec after 2 sec. Stops a grouped pack's casts at once. Bosses are immune
cc
Earthgrab Totem · 30 sec · roots enemies within 8 yards for 8 sec over 20 sec (Stormbringer build). For kiting adds and slowing chasing adds
disp

Cleanse Spirit · 8 sec · removes a curse from an ally. Poison Cleansing Totem · 2 min · removes poison from party members within 30 yards every 1.5 sec for 6 sec (Farseer build). Wowhead sees this poison cleanse as a major Elemental strength this season
tip
Purge: removes 1 beneficial magic effect from an enemy. Earth Elemental (3 min): a taunting elemental for 30 sec. Buys time when the tank dies
pos

Movement: Spiritwalker's Grace (2 min, cast while moving for 15 sec), Gust of Wind (20 sec, leap forward), Ghost Wolf (30% movement speed, can't be slowed below 100%, damage reduction via Spirit Wolf)
tip
Before combat, turn on Skyfury (2% party Mastery) and Lightning Shield. Farseer also uses Flametongue Weapon (Wowhead)
cc
Ascendant week: stun orbs with Capacitor Totem to remove them. Stormbringer can use it more often via Static Charge (Wowhead)
tip
Voidbound week: when the big enemy spawns, kill it fast with short cooldowns like Stormkeeper and Voltaic Blaze (Wowhead)
disp
Devour week: clear party debuffs all at once with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer), or with Cleanse Spirit in a pinch. Ignore the attached slow with Ghost Wolf (Wowhead)
tip
Xal'atath's Guile at +12 and above: each death costs 15 sec

farseer.title: Farseer notes
items: Call the Ancestor with {Stormkeeper} and follow right away with {Ascendance}, lined up with big pulls and boss burst windows
For mechanics that apply poison, drop {Poison Cleansing Totem} first, and save {Ancestral Swiftness} for movement

stormbringer.title: Stormbringer notes
items: When {Tempest} lights up, use it in the burst window, and spend the {Stormkeeper} charge from {Arc Discharge} right away
Root chasing or scattering adds with {Earthgrab Totem} and stun them with {Capacitor Totem}

Rav'i: [광역 피해] Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with the Ssscavenging shield to break it fast
[위치] If targeted by Triple Shot, spread out with Spiritwalker's Grace without stopping your casts
The Writhing Coil: [차단] Put Wind Shear (12 sec) into the rotation for the 3 back-to-back Toxic Atrophy casts
[해제] Clear the Spiteful Venom poison stacking on the Spiteful Hunt target with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build)
[광역 피해] When Uncoil spawns 5 Writhes, line up Ascendance and Earthquake to cleave them together
Zul'jan: [광역 피해] If your health is low during the Ritual of the Fang channel, pop Astral Shift
[위치] If your assigned beam spot is far, Gust of Wind there before the channel starts

Lightblossom Trinity: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Kezkitt's Light Bolt
[광역 피해] The three bosses are stacked, so cleave them together with Chain Lightning and Earthquake
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for the 6 sec Thorncaller Roar AoE damage
[회피] If targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, gain distance from the boss with Ghost Wolf and Gust of Wind
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form
[광역 피해] Save Astral Shift for Spirits of the Vale after 40%
Ziekket: [차단] Before the revive, Wind Shear the Lashers' Lightspore Shot; if several group up, stop them together with Capacitor Totem
[광역 피해] When the Lashers spawn, spread Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze and cleave them with Chain Lightning

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Clear the Toxic Spores poison from Spoiled Supplies mushrooms off the whole party with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build, Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for the Ravenous Bellow AoE physical damage
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Fractured Shivercore's Winter's Shroud
[위치] Before Frozen Tempest, get into the Snowdrift early with Ghost Wolf. Ghost Wolf can't be slowed below 100% movement speed
Nalorakk: [광역 피해] During Fury of the War God, pop Astral Shift before soaking an Echo
[위치] If targeted by Echoing Maul, Gust of Wind to the edge within 4 sec

Kystia Manaheart: [우선 처치] Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with the 20 sec Destabilized window on Kystia
[차단] Wind Shear one Mirror Images clone, and stop grouped clones together with Capacitor Totem
Zaen Bladesorrow: [해제] The Heartstop Poison applied to the tank after Envenom is a poison. Clear it with Poison Cleansing Totem to remove the max health reduction (Farseer build, Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for the Killing Spree AoE damage
Xathuux the Annihilator: [우선 처치] Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with Demonic Rage, when the boss takes 30% more damage
[광역 피해] If an axe is still alive during Infernal Crush, pop Astral Shift
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Chaos Bolt
[제어] When Wild Imps group up, stop their Felfire Burst together with Capacitor Totem and kill them with Earthquake

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for the Dark Bloom party Shadow damage
[위치] Before Umbral Rupture, pop Spiritwalker's Grace and keep casting while moving toward the wall
Atroxus: [해제] Poison Splash and Mind-Numbing Poison are poisons. Clear the party with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build, Wowhead)
[우선 처치] When a Toxic Creeper spawns, focus Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts and Lava Burst on it to kill it fast
Charonus: [위치] If targeted by Gravitic Orbs, use Ghost Wolf to ignore the Condensed Mass slow and drag it to the nearest Unstable Singularity
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for the 20 sec Cosmic Crash DoT

The Golden Serpent: [제어] When Lucre's Call spawns Animated Gold, stun them with Capacitor Totem; Stormbringer can also root them with Earthgrab Totem to delay them reaching the boss
[광역 피해] Kill grouped Animated Gold together with Earthquake and Chain Lightning
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for the Half-Finished Mummy's Wretched Discharge; if two are together, stop them both with Capacitor Totem
[위치] During Entomb, Gust of Wind to reach the shaking coffin quickly
The Council of Tribes: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Zanazal's Poison Nova
[해제] If a Poison Nova interrupt is missed, clear the 12 sec poison DoT with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build, Wowhead)
Dazar, The First King: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Reban's Deathly Roar
[광역 피해] Pop Astral Shift for the 15 sec Gilded Destruction party DoT

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Frigid Shard
[우선 처치] Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with the intermission Ice Bulwark to break it fast
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley
[우선 처치] When a Blazebound Firestorm spawns, swap immediately and kill it with Lava Burst and Stormkeeper-empowered Lightning Bolts
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [참고] Near the end of Interrupting Cloudburst, use only instant casts like Flame Shock and Voltaic Blaze to avoid the lockout
[우선 처치] Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance with the start of phase 2

Adderis & Aspix: [위치] After the Gale Force knockback, Gust of Wind straight back to your Thunder and Lightning soak spot
Merektha: [해제] Clear the Toxic Viper's Poison Spit poison with Poison Cleansing Totem (Farseer build, Wowhead)
[제어] When Hatch adds group up, stun them with Capacitor Totem and kill them together with Chain Lightning
Galvazzt: [위치] On your beam soak turn, pop Astral Shift and keep DPSing with Spiritwalker's Grace
Avatar of Sethraliss: [우선 처치] Line up Stormkeeper and Ascendance on the Essence Defiler to kill it fast
[차단] Put Wind Shear into the rotation for the Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock
[제어] Stun the Faithless Tormentor chasing the healer with Capacitor Totem; Stormbringer can root it with Earthgrab Totem
